description: P5-30, RF-429: a completed run on Catalog and Services, then a Deepen whose first task (the re-read of the rejected Catalog claim) writes twelve BR cards of one claim each, so the claims written could not all be judged at a run cap of 100,000 tokens and the second task (Catalog/Details.aspx) must not start. Written by hand for the fake provider; no real provider was called.
